title: Construction of three-qubit positive-partial-transpose entangled states of rank four
summary: Multiqubit positive-partial-transpose (PPT) entangled states play an important role in quantum information theory. We characterize such states of minimum rank in three-qubit system, namely rank four. Depending on whether the Lorentz invariant is zero, we classify such states into two types. The PPT entangled states constructed by unextendible product bases (UPB) have nonzero invariants, which belong to type I.
